Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (emotion prime: sad vs neutral) x 3 (personal target: self, friend, stranger) x 2 (match vs unmatch); 30 trials per condition

Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 12 (6 self-paced + 6 timed practice, identical structure to test trials); plus 6 demonstration trials with instructions and no prime (not counted)

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: emotion prime 200 ms; shape-label pair 150 ms
Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: Sequential: fixation, schematic sad/neutral emotion-face prime above fixation, 50 ms fixation, then simultaneous shape (above) and person-word label (below)

Colors.Stimulus: white/grey screen, shape images and white label text

exp1b.detail: Experiment 1b of Lee, Martin & Sui (2026, BritJPsy, DOI 10.1111/bjop.70100), sad vs neutral primes. Procedure identical to Experiment 1a except primes were sad and neutral emotional faces. Authors excluded 11 of the 53 complete participants from analyses for chance-level accuracy (mean ACC <=55%; excluded IDs: 325084622, 26988398, 8839912, 873303424, 18582, 766810170, 699174698, 18610, 216462780, 718214387, 18594) -> analysed N=42. Two further logged sessions (349253591, 18542) quit partway (197 and 350 of 360 trials) and are not part of this dataset. Timeout trials are ACC=NA in this database (authors counted them as incorrect). RT_ms is Inquisit latency from pair onset. Sad prime file: s.tif. extraIV1 = emotion prime (sad/neutral). Data source: OSF enfma archive Data_files/E1b_SN_P_data (all *_SAT rows of complete participants; 53 participants x 360 trials = 19080 rows; matched author OSF_analysis.Rmd cleaning exactly).
